title: Flatten Multi-Level Sorted Linked List
problemStatement: You are given a multi-level linked list where each node contains: next pointer child pointer Each child list is individually sorted. Flatten the entire structure into a single sorted linked list using only the child pointers. Return the head of the flattened list.
output: The head of the flattened sorted linked list.
constraints: Total number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5]
